record.paper_title: Properly Coloured Cycles and Paths: Results and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Longest properly coloured cycle in complete graphs
record.original_question: For c ≥ 3, determine how to find a longest properly coloured cycle in a c-edge-coloured complete graph K_n^c, or equivalently resolve the still-unsolved longest properly coloured cycle problem in this setting.

evidence.quote: The problem of finding a longest PC cycle Kc_n has not been solved yet for c ≥ 3 as we will see below.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $c \geq 3$ be an integer. A $c$-edge-coloured complete graph $K_n^c$ is the complete graph on $n$ vertices in which every edge is assigned one of $c$ colours (with no restriction on how the colours are distributed). A cycle $v_1 v_2 \cdots v_k v_1$ in $K_n^c$ is said to be properly coloured if, for every $i$, the two consecutive edges $v_{i-1}v_i$ and $v_i v_{i+1}$ (indices mod $k$) receive distinct colours.

Develop an algorithm (or a structural characterization yielding one) that, given as input any $c$-edge-coloured complete graph $K_n^c$ with $c \geq 3$, determines a properly coloured cycle of maximum possible length in $K_n^c$. Equivalently, resolve the longest properly coloured cycle problem in $c$-edge-coloured complete graphs for all $c \geq 3$.
artifact.category_tag: Properly coloured cycles in edge-coloured graphs
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature (including works on properly coloured cycles in edge-coloured complete graphs published through 2025) continues to investigate partial results — such as long properly coloured cycles, properly coloured cycles of specified lengths, and properly coloured Hamiltonian cycles — but no general solution to the longest properly coloured cycle problem in $K_n^c$ for $c \geq 3$ appears in the located sources. The problem remains active and apparently open.

status_evidence.snippet: Studies properly colored cycles in edge-colored complete graphs as an ongoing research topic.

status_evidence.title: Long properly colored cycles in edge colored complete graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates lower bounds and existence of long properly colored cycles.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results on long PC cycles are known; a general algorithm for the longest such cycle is not provided.

status_evidence.title: Properly Coloured Cycles and Paths: Results and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems including the longest PC cycle problem in K_n^c.
status_evidence.claim: The longest properly coloured cycle problem in K_n^c for c >= 3 is explicitly listed as unsolved.
